body: I noticed you're participating on behalf of Microsoft. That means you cannot sign the contributor's agreement as an individual. Microsoft has already signed up for the Fetch Workstream so you have to join the relevant GitHub organization (MicrosoftWHATWGContributors) and make your membership thereof public.

The change looks good, but wrapping at 100 columns doesn't seem to be done properly. I could address that, but you're welcome to it as well.

Also, https://github.com/whatwg/fetch/pull/1796#pullrequestreview-2753138273 still needs to be resolved to satisfy the IPR bot.
Great, this looks good. When do you expect the tests to be ready? We'll want to land those and this change around the same time.
